summary: Texas oilman H.L. Hunt gambled and pimped his way to an oil fortune, became the world's richest man, kept a secret bigamous family, and spent the 1950s and 1960s flooding US radio and print with self-serving far-right propaganda.

evidence.note: Born in Fayette County, Illinois, in 1889
FBI file: gambling and prostitution in Arkansas funded his entry into oil
1930 move to East Texas and the Joiner well deal that made his fortune
Bigamous second marriage and secret family in Florida, neglect of first family
Facts Forum founded 1951, McCarthy support, fake polls fed to newspapers
Life Line launched with a preacher host to dodge fairness rules, religious framing
Anti-Catholic leaflet against JFK at the 1960 DNC, Senate inquiry
Alpaca novel proposes votes weighted by taxes paid; called a fascist democracy
Health food and supplement firm as sole advertiser on his shows
Decline after Goldwater loss and death in November 1974

notes: Grandfather's Confederate militia (1860s) and a long digression on biographer Jerome Tuccille are left out of covered_span: neither is a story subject. Modern parallels (Musk, Fox News, talk radio, Shapiro) are comparisons, so reaches_present is false. Anti-communist red-scare messaging could also support conspiracy-theories. Daisy Bradford well is called number one in the transcript; historically it was No. 3.
